title: ARG Telemetry Payload
description:
Root envelope that combines all four immutable telemetry blocks into a single signed audit record. One payload is produced per inference turn. The signature covers the content blocks (context + lineage + evaluation); the signed record is the unit of the audit ledger.

Block assembly order:
  1. context  — session identifiers and geography, populated at request time
  2. lineage  — prompt hash, model ID, temperature, populated before inference
  3. evaluation — drift scores and policy decision, populated after inference
  4. signature — hash of blocks 1-3, applied by the enforcement gate before emit

payload_id.description: Unique identifier for this telemetry payload. Used as the primary key in the audit ledger.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope schema. Increment the minor version for backwards-compatible field additions; increment the major version for breaking changes.

context.description: Session identifiers, cohort data, and privacy jurisdiction. Populated at request time before inference.

lineage.description: Deterministic record of model configuration at inference time. Enables forensic reconstruction of any turn.

evaluation.description: Drift scores, guardrail distances, and policy decision from the Orchestration Layer. Populated after inference completes.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature of the assembled payload (context + lineage + evaluation). Applied by the enforcement gate. The payload_hash in this block must equal SHA-256(canonical_json(context, lineage, evaluation)).

wallet_id.description: If this turn was gated by an allocated wallet, the wallet_id links this telemetry record to the corresponding financial governance event stream.

execution_tree_id.description: Agent execution tree this turn belongs to. Present when the turn is part of a multi-agent workflow.

payload_hash_note.description: The payload_hash in the signature block must be computed as: SHA-256(JSON.stringify({context, lineage, evaluation}, sorted_keys)). The envelope fields payload_id, schema_version, wallet_id, and execution_tree_id are NOT included in the hash — only the three content blocks are signed.
